Source [1] (DRA 5.0, 2009) says DRA 5.0 plans a "long surface stay (~500 days)" on Mars.
Source [4] (EMC, 2015) says the Evolvable Mars Campaign plans to enable "Steady State" operations by at least 4 crew for up to 500 sols at a single Mars surface destination.

The sources differ in units: one study uses days, the other uses sols.
